about: Crash reporting with Sentry (sentry-godot, MIT) and Firebase Crashlytics (godot-x/firebase, MIT), both on their free plans. Nothing is sent unless the SDK is installed (tools/crash/install_crash_sdks.sh), the keys below are filled in, AND the player agreed (first-run question or Settings > Send crash reports). Sentry DSNs and Firebase config files are not secrets, but they belong to your accounts.
